product_metadata.title: HOMCOM Kitchen Island Cart Rolling Trolley Cart with Drawer, Storage Cabinet & Towel Rack, White
features: Large Storage: This kitchen island on wheels has ample space to enlarge your storage space. Equipped with a wide countertop, a drawer, and a two-layer cabinet, the kitchen cart provides temporary storage space for abundant ingredients and kitchen utensils. The side towel rail is convenient to hold napkins or hand towels.

Multi-functional: You can put food and spices on the counter, and pushed them into the dining room. Or use the kitchen island table as a child's toy car, kids can use it to place their toys and play freely in different places. It can be used as a tool for transporting large objects. The shelf in the door cabinet is 3-level adjustable to fit different heights of your items.
Sturdy Built: High-quality microwave cart is carefully crafted from rubberwood domestic and MDF, which are sturdy and stable and can be used for a long time.

Easy to Use: With 4 smooth-rolling wheels of 360 degrees, the kitchen island can be convenient to move from kitchen to other places as a coffee bar cabinet. The brakes on two casters help secure the kitchen island to the standing place. The handy towel rack can be also used as a transport handle.
Kitchen Cart Dimensions: Overall Dimensions: 32.75" W x 17.75" D x 36" H. Weight Capacity: 110 lbs (Overall), 6.6 lbs (Drawer), 22 lbs (Shelf).
